name: Carlisle Athletics Track (Sheepmount Stadium)
metaTitle: Carlisle Athletics Track (Sheepmount Stadium) | Info & Wind Speed
metaDescription: Check live wind speed and track information for Carlisle Athletics Track (Sheepmount Stadium) in Carlisle.

trackInfo.heading: Opening Times
trackInfo.text:
Athletics track hours:

Monday – Thursday: 3:00 pm – 8:30 pm
Friday: 3:00 pm – 5:00 pm and 6:00 pm – 8:00 pm
Saturday: 9:00 am – 3:00 pm
Sunday: 9:00 am – 2:00 pm

Hours can change for events and bank holidays, so check with the venue before travelling.

trackInfo.heading: Entry Price
trackInfo.text: The track is open for general use on a pay-as-you-go basis, or with a six-month track pass. Current prices are listed on the operator's website. Exclusive hire is available for clubs, schools and competitions.

trackInfo.heading: Track Details
trackInfo.text:
Length: 400m oval
Lanes: 8
Floodlights: Yes
Field Facilities: Equipped for all field events.
Certification: TrackMark certified to host competitions.

trackInfo.heading: Parking Details
trackInfo.text: Free on-site parking with 52 spaces, including 5 disabled bays.

trackInfo.heading: Address
trackInfo.text: Sheepmount Athletics Stadium, Mayors Drive, Carlisle, Cumbria, CA3 8XL

trackInfo.heading: Website
trackInfo.text: Visit the operator's Sheepmount page for prices, bookings and current opening times.
